about: ULTRAKILL sounds and music the helper plays, read from the player's own ULTRAKILL install ({game:ultrakill}/ULTRAKILL_Data/StreamingAssets/aa/StandaloneWindows64). The helper writes every AudioClip name it finds to clip-index.txt; match is a case-insensitive regex over those names, tried in order. Nothing from ULTRAKILL is shipped.

bundles.desc: File glob of bundles to search

match.desc: Regexes over clip names, first that matches wins

verified.desc: Clip name confirmed in a real clip-index.txt

rows.note: ULTRAKILL has no built-in per-rank sound (mods add one); pick a real UI/reward clip from clip-index.txt
a punchier real clip for S and above; the end-of-level rank sound is the first choice
ULTRAKILL levels ship a calm 'clean' and an intense 'battle' version of each track; the helper pairs them by shared name
